description: This is a shell script used for self-healing network connectivity by performing ping and DNS tests, resetting the router if necessary, and scheduling repeated checks.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current corrective action state from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates and waits for a random delay before starting the ping test.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by triggering a simulated reboot command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Checks the process name and resets the router if the process is PING.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS ping test if enabled, and takes corrective action if DNS resolution fails.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs network ping test to the default gateway and resets the router if packet loss occurs.
